package postgres

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

type storedStep struct {
	ID                      string                           `json:"id"`
	Title                   string                           `json:"title"`
	Objective               string                           `json:"objective"`
	Deliverables            []string                         `json:"deliverables"`
	Acceptance              []domain.Acceptance              `json:"acceptance"`
	MilestoneOrder          int                              `json:"milestone_order"`
	StepOrder               int                              `json:"step_order"`
	Required                bool                             `json:"required"`
	Status                  string                           `json:"status"`
	Targets                 []domain.Target                  `json:"targets"`
	ValidationContract      json.RawMessage                  `json:"validation_contract"`
	EvaluationAssets        domain.EvaluationAssets          `json:"evaluation_assets"`
	RuntimeProfile          json.RawMessage                  `json:"runtime_profile"`
	StarterFiles            []domain.WorkspaceFile           `json:"starter_files"`
	ReadinessReceipt        *domain.LearningReadinessReceipt `json:"readiness_receipt,omitempty"`
	ReadinessIdempotencyKey string                           `json:"readiness_idempotency_key,omitempty"`
}

func storeStep(step domain.Step) storedStep {
	return storedStep{ID: step.ID, Title: step.Title, Objective: step.Objective,
		Deliverables: step.Deliverables, Acceptance: step.Acceptance, MilestoneOrder: step.MilestoneOrder,
		StepOrder: step.StepOrder, Required: step.Required, Status: step.Status, Targets: step.Targets,
		ValidationContract: step.ValidationContract, EvaluationAssets: step.EvaluationAssets,
		RuntimeProfile: step.RuntimeProfile, StarterFiles: step.StarterFiles,
		ReadinessReceipt: step.ReadinessReceipt, ReadinessIdempotencyKey: step.ReadinessIdempotencyKey}
}

func (step storedStep) domainStep() domain.Step {
	return domain.Step{ID: step.ID, Title: step.Title, Objective: step.Objective,
		Deliverables: step.Deliverables, Acceptance: step.Acceptance, MilestoneOrder: step.MilestoneOrder,
		StepOrder: step.StepOrder, Required: step.Required, Status: step.Status, Targets: step.Targets,
		ValidationContract: step.ValidationContract, EvaluationAssets: step.EvaluationAssets,
		RuntimeProfile: step.RuntimeProfile, StarterFiles: step.StarterFiles,
		ReadinessReceipt: step.ReadinessReceipt, ReadinessIdempotencyKey: step.ReadinessIdempotencyKey}
}

type storedInstance struct {
	Instance                domain.TaskInstance         `json:"instance"`
	Steps                   []storedStep                `json:"steps"`
	CurrentStep             *storedStep                 `json:"current_step,omitempty"`
	RevisionSummary         storedRevisionSummary       `json:"revision_summary"`
	RevisionEnvelope        domain.RevisionEnvelope     `json:"revision_envelope"`
	SolutionVariantID       string                      `json:"solution_variant_id,omitempty"`
	StartCommandDigest      string                      `json:"start_command_digest"`
	Provisioning            domain.ProvisioningReceipts `json:"provisioning"`
	ReviewRequired          bool                        `json:"review_required"`
	AssistancePolicyVersion string                      `json:"assistance_policy_version"`
	HintsUsed               int                         `json:"hints_used"`
	MaxHintLevel            *int                        `json:"max_hint_level,omitempty"`
	TeacherAssistanceUsed   bool                        `json:"teacher_assistance_used"`
	Version                 int64                       `json:"version"`
}

type storedRevisionSummary struct {
	Schema         string    `json:"schema"`
	RevisionID     string    `json:"revision_id"`
	Digest         string    `json:"digest"`
	FamilyKey      string    `json:"family_key"`
	VariantKey     string    `json:"variant_key"`
	VariantID      string    `json:"variant_id"`
	RevisionNumber int       `json:"revision_number"`
	Surface        string    `json:"surface"`
	Title          string    `json:"title"`
	Type           string    `json:"type"`
	PublishedAt    time.Time `json:"published_at"`
}

func storeRevisionSummary(summary domain.RevisionSummary) storedRevisionSummary {
	return storedRevisionSummary{Schema: summary.Schema, RevisionID: summary.RevisionID, Digest: summary.Digest,
		FamilyKey: summary.FamilyKey, VariantKey: summary.VariantKey, VariantID: summary.VariantID,
		RevisionNumber: summary.RevisionNumber, Surface: summary.Surface, Title: summary.Title, Type: summary.Type, PublishedAt: summary.PublishedAt}
}

func (summary storedRevisionSummary) domainSummary() domain.RevisionSummary {
	return domain.RevisionSummary{Schema: summary.Schema, RevisionID: summary.RevisionID, Digest: summary.Digest,
		FamilyKey: summary.FamilyKey, VariantKey: summary.VariantKey, VariantID: summary.VariantID,
		RevisionNumber: summary.RevisionNumber, Surface: summary.Surface, Title: summary.Title, Type: summary.Type, PublishedAt: summary.PublishedAt}
}

func marshalInstance(instance domain.TaskInstance) ([]byte, error) {
	steps := make([]storedStep, 0, len(instance.Steps))
	for _, step := range instance.Steps {
		steps = append(steps, storeStep(step))
	}
	var current *storedStep
	if instance.CurrentStep != nil {
		value := storeStep(*instance.CurrentStep)
		current = &value
	}
	return json.Marshal(storedInstance{Instance: instance, Steps: steps, CurrentStep: current,
		RevisionSummary: storeRevisionSummary(instance.RevisionSummary), RevisionEnvelope: instance.RevisionEnvelope,
		SolutionVariantID:  instance.SolutionVariantID,
		StartCommandDigest: instance.StartCommandDigest, Provisioning: instance.Provisioning,
		ReviewRequired: instance.ReviewRequired, AssistancePolicyVersion: instance.AssistancePolicyVersion,
		HintsUsed: instance.HintsUsed, MaxHintLevel: instance.MaxHintLevel,
		TeacherAssistanceUsed: instance.TeacherAssistanceUsed, Version: instance.Version})
}

func unmarshalInstance(raw []byte) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	var record storedInstance
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &record); err != nil {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, err
	}
	instance := record.Instance
	instance.Steps = make([]domain.Step, 0, len(record.Steps))
	for _, step := range record.Steps {
		instance.Steps = append(instance.Steps, step.domainStep())
	}
	instance.CurrentStep = nil
	if record.CurrentStep != nil {
		current := record.CurrentStep.domainStep()
		instance.CurrentStep = &current
	}
	instance.RevisionSummary = record.RevisionSummary.domainSummary()
	instance.RevisionEnvelope = record.RevisionEnvelope
	instance.SolutionVariantID = record.SolutionVariantID
	instance.StartCommandDigest = record.StartCommandDigest
	instance.Provisioning = record.Provisioning
	instance.ReviewRequired = record.ReviewRequired
	instance.AssistancePolicyVersion = record.AssistancePolicyVersion
	instance.HintsUsed = record.HintsUsed
	instance.MaxHintLevel = record.MaxHintLevel
	instance.TeacherAssistanceUsed = record.TeacherAssistanceUsed
	instance.Version = record.Version
	return instance, nil
}

type storedSubmission struct {
	Submission               domain.Submission `json:"submission"`
	ValidationSpecification  json.RawMessage   `json:"validation_specification"`
	ValidationContractDigest string            `json:"validation_contract_digest"`
	RevisionDigest           string            `json:"revision_digest"`
	RequiresHumanReview      bool              `json:"requires_human_review"`
	IdempotencyKey           string            `json:"idempotency_key"`
	CommandDigest            string            `json:"command_digest"`
}

func marshalSubmission(submission domain.Submission) ([]byte, error) {
	return json.Marshal(storedSubmission{Submission: submission,
		ValidationSpecification:  submission.ValidationSpecification,
		ValidationContractDigest: submission.ValidationContractDigest, RevisionDigest: submission.RevisionDigest,
		RequiresHumanReview: submission.RequiresHumanReview, IdempotencyKey: submission.IdempotencyKey,
		CommandDigest: submission.CommandDigest})
}

func unmarshalSubmission(raw []byte) (domain.Submission, error) {
	var record storedSubmission
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &record); err != nil {
		return domain.Submission{}, err
	}
	submission := record.Submission
	submission.ValidationSpecification = record.ValidationSpecification
	submission.ValidationContractDigest = record.ValidationContractDigest
	submission.RevisionDigest = record.RevisionDigest
	submission.RequiresHumanReview = record.RequiresHumanReview
	submission.IdempotencyKey = record.IdempotencyKey
	submission.CommandDigest = record.CommandDigest
	return submission, nil
}

func nullableTime(value *time.Time) any {
	if value == nil || value.IsZero() {
		return nil
	}
	return value.UTC()
}

func nullableUUID(value string) any {
	if value == "" {
		return nil
	}
	return value
}
